# Axentro

> Axentro is a digital solutions company based in Egypt, serving clients in Egypt, the Gulf, and worldwide.
> We design and build websites, business management systems, and AI-powered automation.
> Website: https://axentro.site/ (Arabic) - English site: https://axentro.site/en/

Axentro (اكسنترو) helps businesses digitize and grow: corporate websites and landing pages,
e-commerce stores, booking and clinic management systems, CRM, inventory and invoicing,
QR menus for restaurants, real estate platforms, plus AI automation, systems integration,
business dashboards, and custom business applications. Every solution is built around the
client's actual workflow, with training and ongoing support after launch.

## Services (13)
- [Web Development](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): corporate websites and high-converting landing pages with clean technical SEO.
- [Portfolio & Personal Websites](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): portfolio and CV websites for professionals and job seekers.
- [Booking & Appointment Systems](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): 24/7 self-booking with smart calendars and automatic reminders.
- [Clinic Management Software](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): patient files, appointments, invoicing, and reports for clinics and medical centers.
- [E-commerce Development](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): online stores with catalog, cart, payments, and order management.
- [Inventory & Sales Management](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): stock, invoices, and profit reports connected in one system.
- [CRM Software](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): leads, sales pipeline, follow-ups, and team performance tracking.
- [QR Menu & Online Ordering](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): digital QR menus for restaurants and cafes with instant ordering.
- [Real Estate Listing Platform](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): property listings with search, filters, and map location.
- [AI Automation](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): intelligent workflows that remove repetitive manual work.
- [Business Systems Integration](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): connecting websites, CRM, inventory, WhatsApp, and payment tools via APIs.
- [Dashboards & Business Reports](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): interactive dashboards and KPI reports from your business data.
- [Custom Business Applications](https://axentro.site/en/services.html): tailor-made software built around your exact workflow.
